h1: The 5 Best Lateral Filing Cabinets of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Lateral File Cabinets 2026: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: two true lateral filing cabinets plus three compact vertical alternatives, compared on width, drawers, locks and footprint.
summary: The Letaya 2 Drawer cabinet is the best lateral filing cabinet, a genuinely lateral metal unit 28.35 inches wide with two locking drawers and an anti-tip interlock. The DEVAISE 3-Drawer is the rolling lateral option in a wood-look finish. The Letaya 3-Drawer and DEVAISE 2-Drawer are vertical under-desk pedestals, and the VASAGLE CUSTOS is the narrowest, doubling as a printer stand.
intro: Plenty of cabinets sold as lateral are vertical ones that borrowed the word for the title. A lateral cabinet is wide and shallow, with drawers that slide out along the long side and files that sit side to side. That changes everything about where it fits: it wants a stretch of wall and little front clearance, where a vertical unit wants the opposite.

Our editors evaluated five cabinets from their spec pages, scoring them on the Primea framework with true lateral layout, locks, anti-tip protection, file size support and mobility weighted most. Only two are truly lateral, and three are vertical pedestals that earned a place for other reasons. Prices are buckets, and we say plainly which products are which.

products.name: Letaya 2 Drawer File Cabinet with Lock, Metal Lateral Filing Cabinet for Home Office
products.verdict: A true lateral cabinet with a lock and anti-tip interlock.
products.description:
The Letaya is a genuinely lateral metal cabinet, 28.35 inches wide, with two locking drawers and hanging file support for Letter, Legal and A4. An anti-tip drawer interlock stops two drawers opening at once. It sits in the $50 to $100 bucket. The interlock matters because opening both drawers on a loaded cabinet moves the center of gravity forward and can tip it.

It ranks first because it combines true lateral layout, locks and tip protection, which none of the other lateral model offers in full. The DEVAISE adds a drawer and wheels but no lock.

Buy it for home offices wanting real lateral filing. The caveats are the wide footprint and the need for front clearance. Skip it if floor space is tight.
products.idealFor: Home offices wanting real lateral filing.

products.name: DEVAISE 3-Drawer Mobile File Cabinet, Lateral Filing Cabinet, Rustic Brown
products.verdict: Three lateral drawers on wheels in a wood-look finish.
products.description:
The DEVAISE is a lateral cabinet with three drawers, rolling casters, hanging file support and a rustic brown wood-look finish. It sits in the $50 to $100 bucket. A third drawer adds filing capacity, and casters let you reposition the cabinet when you rearrange the room.

It ranks second because the third drawer and wheels add capacity and flexibility, but no lock is listed, and a rolling cabinet can shift under a heavy load. It is the lateral pick for people who move things.

Buy it for people who reposition their storage. The caveats are no lock and wheels that need a flat floor. Skip it if you need a lockable cabinet.

products.name: Letaya 3 Drawer Mobile File Cabinet with Lock, Under Desk Metal Filing Cabinets
products.verdict: More drawers than a lateral cabinet in far less width.
products.description:
This Letaya is a vertical mobile pedestal, not lateral, with three locking drawers, full assembly and an under-desk fit. It handles Letter, Legal and A4 and sits in the $50 to $100 bucket. Under-desk placement uses space you already have, and a fully assembled cabinet saves a flat-pack ordeal.

Bronze here is because it is not lateral, but it delivers more drawers than the lateral cabinets in far less width. For small desks, that is a fair trade, and it has the lock the DEVAISE lacks.

Buy it for small desks needing locked storage. The caveats are that it is not a lateral cabinet and the pull-out reach is deeper. Skip it if you specifically want lateral filing.

products.name: DEVAISE 2 Drawer Metal File Cabinet, Fully Assembled, Under Desk, Black
products.verdict: A tidy assembled pedestal that tucks under a standard desk.
products.description:
The DEVAISE 2-drawer is a vertical pedestal, not lateral, arriving fully assembled with a lock, under-desk fit and Letter, Legal and A4 support. It falls in the $100 to $200 bucket. A pedestal tucks beneath a standard desk, so it adds filing without taking any wall.

It ranks fourth because it costs more than the Letaya pedestal while offering one fewer drawer. The lock and assembly are the points in its favor.

Buy it for desks needing a ready-to-use file drawer. The caveats are that it is not lateral and is pricey for two drawers. Skip it if you want the most drawers per dollar.

whatMatters.detail: Lateral cabinets are wide with files stored side to side, while vertical ones are narrow and deep. Lateral needs wall space, vertical needs pull-out room. Check the listed width before ordering, and measure the wall and the space in front, since both decide whether the cabinet fits. A lateral cabinet with the drawer pulled out is deeper than most people expect.

A lock keeps documents private and tamper-resistant. Not all cabinets include one. Look for the word lock in the listing, and check how many drawers it covers, because a single lock may secure only the top drawer, which defeats the purpose for important papers. Keep the key somewhere other than the desk.

An interlock lets only one drawer open at once so the cabinet cannot tip forward. It matters on tall or loaded units. Check the feature list, as the Letaya lists it, and be cautious with cabinets that omit it, especially if you plan to fill the drawers with paper. Paper is heavy, and a full lateral drawer has real weight.

Letter, Legal and A4 hanging file support decide what you can store. Legal files need extra width. Verify the sizes in the specs, and think about the paper you actually keep, since a cabinet that does not take Legal folders forces you into awkward workarounds. Legal folders are wider than Letter ones.

Wheels let you move the cabinet but can shift under load. Locking casters help. Read whether the listing says rolling or fixed, and place a rolling cabinet on a flat floor, because a loaded one can drift when you pull a drawer all the way out. Locking casters would solve this, but few listings mention them.

faq.q: Is a lateral cabinet better than a vertical one?
faq.a: It uses wall space instead of depth and stores files side to side. It suits wide walls, as with the 28.35 inch Letaya, and it needs little front clearance. A vertical unit is better when floor depth is spare and wall length is short.

Trusting the word lateral in the title. Check the width, since three of the five cabinets here are vertical. Compare the listing's measured width to the long dimension of a lateral cabinet, which is usually near 28 inches or more.

faq.q: Is the DEVAISE worth it over the Letaya?
faq.a: If you need three drawers and wheels. Otherwise the Letaya has a lock and anti-tip, which the DEVAISE lateral lacks. Capacity is the only real reason to pay for the DEVAISE.
The Letaya and under-desk pedestals list Legal support. Check the others on the product page before buying, particularly the DEVAISE and VASAGLE, whose listings do not confirm Legal support.

faq.q: How do I stop it tipping?
faq.a: Load heavy files low and use an interlock model like the Letaya. Never open two drawers at once on a rolling unit, because even a loaded cabinet can shift or tilt with two pulled out.
Some arrive assembled, like the pedestals, others need it. Read the listing, because flat-pack metal is slow to build and sharp edges need gloves. The fully assembled pedestals save an afternoon.

finalTake: Buy the Letaya 2 Drawer if you want true lateral filing with a lock, and the DEVAISE 3-Drawer if mobility and capacity matter more. The Letaya 3-Drawer and DEVAISE 2-Drawer suit buyers who really want a vertical under-desk pedestal. The VASAGLE is the compact corner solution. Check the width, because the word lateral in a title proves nothing.
